architecture_decisions: 10-minute monitoring is a watchdog mechanism, not a forced 10-minute iteration cycle.
RUNNING must be distinguished from actual progress using heartbeat and last_progress timestamps.
WAITING_FOR_HUMAN is not considered a failure or stall.
Automatic recovery must not cross the boundary into high-risk external actions or medical decisions without human approval.
The watchdog monitors execution continuity; the execution/recovery runner is a separate component.

Long-running autonomy must be hosted outside the ChatGPT response lifecycle; the repository contains the persistent runner contract and self-hosted execution workflow, but the live runner is not connected.
Synthetic data is an engineering fixture only and cannot support claims about real-world clinical performance.
